clinical_interpretation: Encounter contains two or more events of the same activity type within the same visit.
operational_impact: Operational - Reflects multi-test panels, follow-up evaluations, or split pharmacy dispensing.

clinical_interpretation: Patient underwent multiple laboratory examinations during a single OPD encounter.
operational_impact: Operational - Normal clinical practice for comprehensive metabolic or multi-analyte panels.

deviation_pattern: Diagnostic Precedence Deviation: Any Diagnostic Before Consultation
clinical_interpretation: Diagnostic service occurred prior to physician consultation; indicates walk-in diagnostic, standing pre-visit order, or direct radiology/lab arrival before clinical review.
operational_impact: Moderate - May indicate pre-authorized diagnostics or triage pathways; requires coordination review.

deviation_pattern: Sequence Inversion: Imaging Procedure Before Consultation
clinical_interpretation: Patient completed X-ray or ultrasound before seeing the consulting physician.
operational_impact: Moderate - Frequently reflects trauma/triage imaging or routine pre-appointment diagnostic protocols.

clinical_interpretation: Patient had multiple physician consultation events in one encounter.
operational_impact: Operational - Re-consultation following diagnostic review or multi-specialty OPD assessment.

deviation_pattern: Sequence Inversion: Laboratory Examination Before Consultation
clinical_interpretation: Blood or specimen collection occurred prior to physician consultation.
operational_impact: Low to Moderate - Reflects routine fasting blood draws or standing disease monitoring orders.

clinical_interpretation: Encounter record shows a clinical activity timestamp preceding the recorded registration time.
operational_impact: Low - Often caused by retrospective clerk registration or unscheduled urgent clinical entry.

deviation_pattern: Start Activity Deviation: First is 'Imaging Procedure'
clinical_interpretation: Initial recorded encounter event is imaging; registration entered later in EMR.
operational_impact: Low - Direct departmental walk-in with delayed central reception entry.

deviation_pattern: Start Activity Deviation: First is 'Laboratory Examination'
clinical_interpretation: Initial recorded encounter event is phlebotomy/lab draw.
operational_impact: Low - Phlebotomy completed at early morning collection before registration desk processing.

clinical_interpretation: Patient underwent multiple imaging examinations (e.g. multi-view X-ray or ultrasound).
operational_impact: Operational - Multi-anatomical imaging or repeated views.

clinical_interpretation: Prescription items dispensed in multiple separate fulfillment batches.
operational_impact: Operational - Batch fulfillment, compound medications, or multiple pharmacy counters.

deviation_pattern: Flow Designation Mismatch: Activity Set vs Flow Code
clinical_interpretation: Case contains activities that deviate from the standard activity set of its clinical flow code.
operational_impact: Low - Minor classification discordance (e.g. supplementary imaging order in routine lab flow).

deviation_pattern: Flow 2 with Unexpected Activity: Imaging Procedure
clinical_interpretation: Encounter classified as Flow 2 (Appointment -> Prescription -> Lab) also received Imaging.
operational_impact: Low - Ad-hoc physician addition of imaging during an intended lab-only visit.

deviation_pattern: Flow 1 with Unexpected Activity: Imaging Procedure
clinical_interpretation: Encounter classified as Flow 1 (Consultation only) received an ad-hoc Imaging Procedure.

deviation_pattern: Start Activity Deviation: First is 'Doctor Consultation & Prescription'
clinical_interpretation: Immediate physician evaluation recorded before clerk registration entry.
operational_impact: Low - Urgent clinical consultation or expedited clinician order entry.

clinical_interpretation: Clinician consultation timestamp strictly precedes appointment registration timestamp.

deviation_pattern: Flow 1 with Unexpected Activity: Laboratory Examination
clinical_interpretation: Encounter classified as Flow 1 (Consultation only) received an ad-hoc Laboratory Examination.

deviation_pattern: Flow 1 with Unexpected Activity: Imaging Procedure, Laboratory Examination
clinical_interpretation: Encounter classified as Flow 1 received both ad-hoc Lab and Imaging procedures.
